description: Figure 5, titled "Distribution of deceived conversations (%) across varying degrees of ambiguity," is a horizontal bar chart that visualizes the proportion of conversations categorized by their level of deception and ambiguity. The chart displays four distinct categories on the vertical axis: "Academic Collaboration," "Recruitment," "Academic Funding," and "Journalism." For each category, a single horizontal bar is segmented into three colored portions representing the degree of deception: red for "Yes" (fully deceived), yellow for "Partially" deceived, and green for "No" deception. The horizontal axis, labeled "Number of Conversations," quantifies the count for each segment. Visually, the "Academic Funding" scenario shows the largest red segment, indicating the highest number of fully deceived conversations, followed by "Recruitment." The "Journalism" scenario has the largest yellow segment, suggesting a high proportion of partially deceived conversations. The "Academic Collaboration" scenario shows a more balanced distribution across all three categories. The chart includes a legend to the right of the bars, clearly associating each color with its corresponding deception level. The overall layout suggests a comparison of deception outcomes across different conversational contexts, with the length of each colored segment reflecting the absolute number of conversations falling into that specific deception category.
